comments.text:
Fewer than 200 of the Maldives' 1,192 islands are home to Maldivians. If you had one week there, which stop would you take the boat to first: the fish market in Malé, the farm island of Thoddoo, or Fuvahmulah and its tiger sharks?

If you enjoyed this journey, these three are close neighbors in spirit:
Living in Mauritius, another Indian Ocean island beyond the resorts: https://youtu.be/S5FRmDstxko
Living in the Marshall Islands, life on low coral atolls: https://youtu.be/rHZuOKtfWSQ
Living in Vanuatu, remote Pacific islands: https://youtu.be/00Wc0J7_u-M
